headline: Reviewers test Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra and Nvidia's new RTX Spark laptops
summary: Reviewers tested Nvidia's new RTX Spark chip and laptops built around it, including Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra, pitched as a MacBook Pro competitor. Assessments varied: one reviewer found it nearly dethrones Apple but for battery life, another said it mostly delivers on Microsoft's promise of one machine for development, AI, and gaming, and a third said the Windows experience is largely unchanged, with RTX Spark benefiting mainly AI enthusiasts.

claims.statement: Tom's Hardware tested the RTX Spark chip against competing Apple and AMD chips to assess it for the 'agentic AI era.'

sources.quote: We've tested Nvidia's RTX Spark against the latest and greatest from Apple and AMD to see how Nvidia's efforts to transform the PC for the agentic AI era stack up.

claims.statement: RTX Spark laptops were found to benefit general Windows PC use, not just users needing local AI.

sources.quote: NVIDIA's RTX Spark is good for Windows, even if you don't need local AI

claims.statement: Reviewers positioned the Surface Laptop Ultra as a Windows competitor to the MacBook Pro.

sources.quote: Surface Laptop Ultra review: a different kind of MacBook Pro
The Surface Laptop Ultra is a true MacBook Pro competitor for Windows, and Microsoft has never been so close to dethroning Apple

claims.statement: One review found the Windows experience on the Surface Laptop Ultra largely unchanged, with only AI enthusiasts benefiting most from RTX Spark.

sources.quote: Microsoft’s Surface Laptop Ultra is its most beautiful laptop ever, but using Windows on it is the same as ever. Only AI enthusiasts will get the most out of RTX Spark.

claims.statement: Ars Technica found the Surface Laptop Ultra delivers on most, but not all, of Microsoft's promise of one machine for development, AI, and gaming.

sources.quote: Microsoft promises one machine for dev, AI, and gaming, and mostly gets there.

claims.statement: Wired said the Surface Laptop Ultra's biggest shortcoming was its battery life.

sources.quote: if only it weren't for the lack of battery life

claims.statement: The Verge spent a week testing multiple RTX Spark laptops built around the Arm-based N1X processor.

sources.quote: Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X processor is finally here, and we've been collectively testing a small fortune's worth of powerful laptops sporting this new "superchip."

claims.statement: The Register benchmarked an RTX Spark notebook, HP's OmniBook Ultra 16, finding serious local AI compute at a price.

sources.quote: Benchmarked: Nvidia's RTX Spark notebook delivers serious local AI compute, at a price

discrepancies.explanation: Reviewers characterized the Surface Laptop Ultra differently: one said it is close to besting Apple if not for battery life, another said it mostly delivers on Microsoft's promises, and a third said the Windows experience is unchanged with only AI enthusiasts benefiting.

quotes.quote: Only AI enthusiasts will get the most out of RTX Spark.
if only it weren't for the lack of battery life
Microsoft promises one machine for dev, AI, and gaming, and mostly gets there.
